1.consolidated_definition: El gallo que propina frecuentemente golpes a su enemigo con las patas o codos, fracasada la intención de herir con las espuelas (cfr. palo ‘dicho golpe’ en Canarias).
1.en_consolidated_definition: The rooster that frequently delivers blows to its enemy with the feet or elbows, having failed in the intention of wounding with the spurs (cf. palo 'said blow' in the Canary Islands).
